title: David Grusch testimony and ICIG report

tellings.quote: Wait a second. Didn't David Grusch raise his hand and say that we have been generationally exploiting non-human technology hand to God and to country

plain: A man named David Grusch is said to have sworn, before Washington, that the United States has been "generationally exploiting non-human technology", in other words studying and using machines that humans did not make. The filmmaker Jeremy Corbell brings this up on Michels' show in 2026 as something Grusch said publicly, "hand to God and to country", and ties it to a report from the Inspector General of the Intelligence Community, the office that looks into complaints inside the US spy agencies. If true, it would mean the government has been keeping such technology for generations.
